clauses.title: PAN format
clauses.text: PAN must be 10 characters: five letters, four digits, one letter. Reject unreadable or malformed PAN numbers and request a clear copy.

clauses.title: Blacklist
clauses.text: Applications presenting a PAN on the fraud blacklist must be escalated to the fraud team immediately; do not inform the applicant.

clauses.title: ID validity
clauses.text: Photo ID must be valid on the application date. Expired identity documents are not acceptable; request a current ID.

clauses.title: Customer record match
clauses.text: Name, date of birth and PAN on the application must match the existing customer record. A PAN registered to a different customer indicates possible forgery and must be escalated.

clauses.title: Income eligibility
clauses.text: Minimum verified monthly income is INR 25,000 for any loan application.

clauses.title: Loan-to-income cap
clauses.text: Requested loan amount must not exceed five times verified annual income.

clauses.title: Large loans
clauses.text: Loans above INR 50,00,000 require senior underwriter review regardless of automated checks.

clauses.title: Income consistency
clauses.text: Stated income more than 50 percent above the income on record must be supported by fresh salary proof before processing.
